attributes.name: Blighted Myrmidon
attributes.powers:
When you encounter a boon that lists Survival in its check to acquire, recharge this card to banish the boon; if it is your exploration, explore again.

Discard this card to add 1d6 to your check against a bane, or 1d12 if the bane has the Animal or Plant trait.

Discard this card to explore your location.

After playing this card, a character at your location may bury a card that lists Survival in its check to acquire; if he does, recharge this card instead of discarding it.
